audit.schema_result: additive; optional new records and one optional adopter extension
audit.engine_protocol_result: new protocol surface; no prior 3.0.2 protocol operation removed; major remains 1

statement: The compatibility audit supports a 3.1.0 MINOR release. It found no mandatory incompatible schema or semantic rule change, no removal of an existing CLI command family, and no prior engine protocol to break. The release decision must preserve the distinction between additive capabilities and adopter pin migration.
